title: Fees & payments overview
answer: Tuition and fees can be paid via the Student Portal (debit/credit card, JomPAY), bank transfer to CIMB, or at the Finance Cashier Counter (Student HQ, Block A). Check the Academic Calendar for due dates. For instalment plans or extensions, contact Treasury Services ServiceDesk.

title: Tuition fee due date
answer: Check the Academic Calendar or Important Dates in the Student Portal for the current due date. Late payment penalties may apply. Treasury Services ServiceDesk can help with extensions or instalment plan requests.

title: Late payment consequences
aliases: what happens if i don't pay fees
answer: Unpaid fees may lead to limited portal access, deregistration, withheld results or awards, penalties, and re-registration charges.

title: Instalment payment plan
answer: Students who cannot settle fees by the due date may apply for a tuition fee instalment plan through Treasury Services ServiceDesk. Long semesters typically support 30% downpayment, 50% downpayment, or 10-month plans. Submit early to avoid late penalties.

title: View instalment plan in portal
aliases: where can i see my instalment plan
answer: Approved instalment payment plans can be viewed in the Student Portal.

title: How Malaysian students pay fees
aliases: how do i pay my fees
answer: Malaysian students can pay through the Student Portal (debit/credit card), JomPAY, direct bank-in or online transfer to CIMB, or at the Finance Cashier Counter.

title: How international students pay fees
aliases: how do i pay as international student
answer: International students can pay via the Student Portal, Flywire for overseas payments, telegraphic transfer, direct bank-in or online transfer, or at the Finance Cashier Counter if they have access to Malaysian banking. CIMB SWIFT: CIBBMYKL.

title: Finance Cashier Counter
aliases: where to pay fees in person
answer: The Finance Cashier Counter is at Student HQ, Block A, Ground Floor. Hours: 8.30 am–5.00 pm Mon–Fri (Friday break 12.00 pm–2.00 pm). Closed weekends and public holidays.
